summary: Issue #1751 slice 3 reassessment of the q44 participation route fixed in docs/notes/q44-inferential-dependency.md. The 11 legacy-only GOD_4-route premises counted for this slice (the open targets of legacy attempt 74008d2a, which cites this note) were already current through slice 2's 5c7bc356 at baseline 95ed6125265252988b7a88ad14e42fed79e9d8ec. Slice 2 deferred the source-selection detail of six of them (11e24b50, cbb068e8, b4987085, 6acd44eb, e2bfd1b1, dcf4bcdd) to this note and stated that it supplies no numerical unity. This assessment covers those six, the four numerical-unity and population inputs with no attempt (inventory 2495a71d, no added difference f13d1cdd, no matter 38ed105c, population 33f3c4c5), and route nodes a576300f, de05072a and 8b8bb6df. 75b5b027 (9f771edb and the De ente 2026-11-17 judgment) and 6dfe01ab, 7fcfcee8, 14325c83, bc1810e5 and 86d02b69 (5c7bc356) keep their assessments, reused unchanged. Whole q44 note, De ente note stages and rivals, the necessary-simple-plurality individuation audit and narrower-bridge sections reread; dossier, brief and context retrieved for the new targets and 860eae63. Three conditional support bundles for CREATURE_1 612078bf are compared (legacy parent 38bef29c, essential-source selection 3beb5720, ancestor source supply ac416809). New first grades: f13d1cdd and 38ed105c strong as source-internal readings, their application to the profile maps an unassessed interpretive bridge (the converse esse-tantum reading choice of claims 8bca93ec and e2319cd1, shared with e2bfd1b1's significance; 6acd44eb supplies only the forward direction; no disambiguation record exists); 33f3c4c5 strong prima facie; 2495a71d moderate, with its exhaustiveness contested. Objections: kept 1 (bare numerical difference with common nature against 2495a71d's exhaustiveness, unresolved, not a counterexample); restated 5; God-indexed Q11 boundary retained; no substantive objection identified for composition-transitivity worries and seven premises. e2bfd1b1 stays ungraded because 457698e4 and fd12ad3d are not assessed here. No theorem, Challenge, claim, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Test the scope of composition b4987085 against the registered per se split: under the open bridge e74de400 every supply-chain link after the first starts from a caused cause and so is per se. Its warrant concentrates in participation coverage 11e24b50 (moderate), composition b4987085 (moderate, scope open), the ancestry inputs 457698e4 and fd12ad3d (not assessed here) and numerical unity a576300f. Of a576300f's newly assessed inputs, f13d1cdd and 38ed105c are strong as source-internal readings, but their application to these profile maps is an unassessed interpretive bridge (the converse esse-tantum reading choice of claims 8bca93ec and e2319cd1, shared with e2bfd1b1's significance; 6acd44eb supplies only the forward direction) and 33f3c4c5 is strong prima facie; the uniqueness load rests on the contested exhaustiveness of 2495a71d (moderate; kept bare-difference challenge) and on the application of 75b5b027 (positively motivated primitive, unchanged). e2bfd1b1 is conditional and ungraded. No GOD_4 naming, efficiency, conservation, necessity or God-indexed uniqueness is used; nothing is established or defeated.
